name: browser-control
description: Interactive browser automation. Allows Prometheus to click, type, and navigate real websites using Puppeteer.

browser_open.description: Opens a Chrome instance and navigates to the URL. If a browser is already open, it reuses the session.

browser_click.description: Clicks an element on the current page. Supports CSS selectors or exact text matches.

selector.description: The CSS selector (e.g. 'button.submit') or text (e.g. 'Login') to click.

browser_type.description: Types text into a specified input field.

selector.description: The CSS selector of the input field.

pressEnter.description: Whether to press Enter after typing.

browser_wait.description: Pauses execution until a selector appears or a timeout is reached.

selector.description: The CSS selector to wait for.

browser_screenshot.description: Takes a screenshot of the current browser page and saves it to data/screenshots/.

fileName.description: Optional name for the screenshot file (e.g. 'homepage.png').

browser_extract_text.description: Extracts the visible text from the page or a specific element.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector to target (defaults to 'body').

browser_close.description: Closes the current browser session and releases memory.
